headlines.title: Vance says Republicans should ‘stop whining’ about Vivek Ramaswamy’s attack ad if they want to win
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance told Republicans to “stop whining” about Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy’s controversial ad featuring his Democratic opponent Amy Acton’s estranged mother.

headlines.title: Who is Stephen Hubbard, the retired American teacher freed by Russia?
headlines.description: Stephen James Hubbard, a retired American teacher, was released by Russia on Wednesday after nearly five years in detention in the midst of an apparent warming of ties between Washington and Moscow.

headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump policy restricting treatment for transgender prison inmates
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday said the Trump administration cannot enforce a new policy that restricts treatment for transgender inmates in federal prison.

headlines.title: Woman sexually assaulted at fraternity near University of Chicago, lawsuit alleges
headlines.description: The new allegations mark the second case of alleged sexual assault to roil the University of Chicago in a matter of days.

headlines.title: Evacuation zones expanded after chemical tank explosion in Toledo, Ohio
headlines.description: A chemical tank explosion at a north Toledo company released a chemical into the air overnight and prompted an evacuation of nearby residents. Glycol methacrylate, an industrial coating product, was released into the air after Tuesday night’s explosion, Toledo Mayor Wade Kapszukiewicz told reporters.

headlines.title: Russians locked out of bank accounts and apartments as Ukraine hits data centers
headlines.description: The strikes that took place over several days earlier this month were the first publicized attacks on Russian data centers.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.title: Tennessee Titans cut DL Jordan Elliott after he allegedly brought a gun to team facility
headlines.description: The Tennessee Titans cut defensive lineman Jordan Elliott after he brought a gun to the team’s training facility in a “terrible lapse of judgement,” officials said Wednesday.

headlines.title: DOJ IG refuses to investigate Reflecting Pool case after Trump’s false claims
headlines.description: The Justice Department’s inspector general is refusing to investigate what went wrong with the botched criminal case against former Olympic canoeist David Hearn over damage at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, including whether there was any criminality on prosecutors’ parts, Hearn’s legal team said.

headlines.title: Critical vulnerabilities in commonly used web code spark rush to update systems
headlines.description: Crucial vulnerabilities in the PHP language is so severe that global authorities have recommended websites temporarily go offline until it can be fixed.
